fields.finding: Half-ultimate Kapton/PEN/Vectran values are assumptions, not creep-rupture allowables. Kapton design gauge 843 um exceeds opened 12.7-125 um rows; PEN 927 um exceeds the 250 um strength row and transfers 25 um modulus/permeability. Kapton 115.5 MPa exceeds its 69 MPa stress at 3% yield and 90 MPa at 5% strain. Long-term shape is unqualified.
fields.proposed_next: Retain gauge and sustained-load transfer assumptions; qualify the fabricated membrane and joints.
